episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Momo believes in ghosts. Okarun believes in aliens. To make each other believe what they deny, they head to a spot famous for UFO sightings and a spiritual hotspot.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Momo awakens psychic powers, while Okarun is cursed by Turbo Granny. They evacuate to Momo's house, but a giant alien appears before them.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: After Momo's grandmother temporarily suppresses the evil spirit within Okarun, she says that a game of tag may be the key to defeating it for good.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Okarun and Momo arrive at the tunnel to confront Turbo Granny. Just when they think they've won, a giant crab spirit crashes through the wall.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Momo and Okarun’s ordeal with Turbo Granny has brought them closer, but things remain awkward between them. Okarun realizes he still has a problem.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Turbo Granny reveals that Okarun's missing organs are contained within golden spheres. Aira, who has found one, now has the ability to see spirits.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Momo and Okarun manage to weaken Acrobatic Silky but make a shocking discovery regarding Aira. Acrobatic Silky suggests a surprising way to help.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Aira begins to develop a crush on Okarun. As the three friends’ emotions intertwine, they suddenly face another extraterrestrial emergency.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Wielding Acrobatic Silky's power, Aira fights the Serpoians alongside Okarun and Momo. The frustrated Serpoians power up their crustacean-like minion.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Okarun and the girls try to clean up some misunderstandings with their classmates. Later, the aquatic creature reappears before Momo and Aira.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Momo's childhood friend Jiji has come to stay with the Ayases. He explains that he needs Seiko’s help with some strange phenomena at his house.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Momo and Okarun head to Jiji's house in a hot springs district to investigate the case of Jiji's family. Okarun feels gloomy looking at how close Momo and Jiji are. Arriving at Jiji's house, there are several shadows watching them as they enter...

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Unwilling to leave Jiji behind, Okarun helps Momo escape to the surface. Momo then begins forming a plan to expose the Death Worm to sunlight.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 2 Episode 5

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The hayashi musicians arrive and begin an energetic exorcism performance. But just when the ritual is about to succeed, Jiji makes a surprising plea.

episodes_data.title: Dan Da Dan Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Okarun has an awkward time at the maid café where Momo works. Seiko tries teaching Jiji how to suppress Evil Eye's possession of his body.
